title: Rift Rascal: The Infinite Cosmic Flea Market
description: Blast-jump, grapple rifts, scoop strange salvage, cut absurd deals, and turn bizarre artifacts into upgrades in a vertical pocket-universe flea market.

defaultCaptions.x: Rift Rascal: a cosmic flea-market adventure where every piece of junk might be legendary.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Blast-jump between floating market islands, collect strange salvage, trade with bizarre vendors, and survive Market Mayhem in Rift Rascal.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Rift Rascal is a fast, playful cosmic salvage adventure packed with rifts, contracts, upgrades, oddities, and mayhem.
defaultCaptions.discord: Open a shift in Rift Rascal: The Infinite Cosmic Flea Market. Scoop everything that is not bolted down.
